# Code of Conduct

Be respectful. Disagreements about design or implementation are normal and welcome here, keep them focused on the work, not the person. Harassment, personal attacks, and discriminatory language or behavior aren't tolerated. Assume good faith, give constructive feedback, and be receptive to it in return.

## Scope

This applies to all project spaces: issues, pull requests, discussions, and any other communication related to localscore.

## Reporting

If you experience or witness behavior that violates this, or just want to raise a concern privately, contact the maintainer directly rather than opening a public issue. See the repository owner's GitHub profile for contact options. Reports will be handled with discretion.

## Enforcement

This is a small, personal project maintained by one person. The maintainer has final say on how a report is handled, and on scope or design disagreements that can't be resolved through discussion. A response depends on severity and can range from a private conversation to removing comments, closing issues or pull requests, or blocking a user from the repository.
